meta.title: Heaven on Earth:
meta.footer: Bible Study — November 10  ·  Ordinary Glory: Heaven on Earth  ·  Scripture from the NIV

summary.speaker: Pastor Chris
summary.bigIdea: Heaven is a place of reunion where love never ends, we are fully known, and God’s grace makes room for everyone.
summary.overview: Pastor Chris continues the series about heaven by asking whether the people we love and have lost may be closer than we think. He shares how remembering them gives us courage. Then he describes heaven as a home where love is complete.

points.title: A Cloud of Witnesses
points.text: Hebrews says we are surrounded by a great crowd of people who have gone before us. Maya Angelou said she brought everyone who had been kind to her on stage with her. We can remember them, thank God, and run our race with our eyes on Jesus.

points.title: Made for Love, Room for Everyone
points.text: God made us for community, and love has no end date. Jesus promises that his Father’s house has room for everyone. Because every person is made in God’s image, we treat each other with honor.

points.title: Fully Known, Fully Loved
points.text: Paul says that now we see only in part, but in heaven we will know and be fully known. Misunderstanding will end. The risen Jesus was recognizable and ate with his friends, so we can expect to recognize one another.

points.title: Grace and the Hope of Reunion
points.text: Heaven is God’s gift, not something we earn, and even a small faith is enough. Jesus came to save, not to judge. Mary heard Jesus say her name, and one day we will hear the voices we miss.

summary.takeaway: This week, remember someone who loved you, thank God for them, and pass that same love on to someone near you.

heb12.text: “Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles. And let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us, fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before him he endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.”

gen2.text: “The LORD God said, ‘It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.’”

john14.text: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in me. My Father’s house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you? And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.”

cor13.text: “Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away. For we know in part and we prophesy in part, but when completeness comes, what is in part disappears. When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I put the ways of childhood behind me. For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known. And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.”

luke24.text: “While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, ‘Peace be with you.’ They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost. He said to them, ‘Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds? Look at my hands and my feet. It is I myself! Touch me and see; a ghost does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.’ When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet. And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, ‘Do you have anything here to eat?’ They gave him a piece of broiled fish, and he took it and ate it in their presence.”

eph2.text: “For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast.”

john3.text: “For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life. For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.”

matt17.text: “Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”

john20.text: “Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus’ body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot. They asked her, ‘Woman, why are you crying?’ ‘They have taken my Lord away,’ she said, ‘and I don’t know where they have put him.’ At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus. He asked her, ‘Woman, why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?’ Thinking he was the gardener, she said, ‘Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him.’ Jesus said to her, ‘Mary.’ She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, ‘Rabboni!’ (which means Teacher). Jesus said, ‘Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, “I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.”’ Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: ‘I have seen the Lord!’ And she told them that he had said these things to her.”

thess4.text: “Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you do not grieve like the rest of mankind, who have no hope. For we believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him. According to the Lord’s word, we tell you that we who are still alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep. For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first. After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever. Therefore encourage one another with these words.”

angelou.name: Maya Angelou
angelou.role: Poet & Author · On Facing Hard Days
angelou.quote: The thing to do, it seems to me, is to prepare yourself so that you can be a rainbow in somebody else’s cloud.

lewis.name: C.S. Lewis
lewis.role: Author & Theologian · The Weight of Glory
lewis.quote: There are no ordinary people. You have never talked to a mere mortal.

willard.name: Dallas Willard
willard.quote: Heaven is for everybody who can stand that much love.

donne.name: John Donne
donne.quote: One short sleep past, we wake eternally, and death shall be no more; Death, thou shalt die.

questions.text: Who is someone, living or gone, whose example helps you keep going?
What is one small way a person can bring comfort to someone who is having a hard week?
Think of a group that made you feel welcome. What did they do that helped?
How might we treat people differently if we saw each person as made for eternity?
Think of a time when you misunderstood someone, or they misunderstood you. What helped close the gap?
Think of a time when surprise or fear turned into joy. What changed?
What makes it hard for people to accept a gift they did not earn?
What object, food, or place helps people feel connected to someone they love who is far away or gone?

prayer.label: Closing Prayer
prayer.text:
Dear God,

Thank you for the people who have loved us and gone before us. Thank you that we are surrounded by their example, and that love never ends.

Help us to keep our eyes on Jesus and to run our race with hope. Make us people who bring comfort and kindness to others, like a rainbow in someone else’s cloud.

Thank you that you made us for community and that in your Father’s house there is room for everyone. Teach us to see every person as made in your image.

Thank you that one day we will know and be fully known, with no more misunderstanding. Thank you that your gift of grace is not earned, and that even a small faith is enough.

For those who miss someone they love, give comfort and peace in the promise of reunion.

We ask this in the name of Jesus. Amen.
prayer.source: — Based on this week’s study: a cloud of witnesses, made for love, fully known, and the hope of reunion in heaven.
